privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:
Last updated: October 21, 2026

1. Who runs this site

captainsolo.ca is run by Solomon Olufelo (Captain Solo), Brampton, Ontario. Questions about this policy go to work@captainsolo.ca.

2. What this site collects

Only what you type into the contact form: your name, email, optional phone number, the service and budget you pick, and your message. The form sends it to my inbox as an email. The site doesn’t keep a copy in a database.

There are no accounts, no analytics, no ad trackers and no cookies. If you switch between light and dark mode, that choice is saved in your own browser (local storage) and never sent anywhere.

3. How it’s used

  • To reply to you and quote or deliver the work you asked about.
  • Never sold, rented, or added to a mailing list.

I keep messages for as long as I need them to reply and finish the work, then delete them on request.

4. Services involved

  • Cloudflare hosts the site and delivers the contact-form email. Like any web host, it handles your IP address to serve pages and block abuse. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy.
  • AirGigs: voice-tag orders placed on AirGigs are covered by AirGigs’ privacy policy.
  • Cal.com: if you book a call, the booking calendar on /book is Cal.com’s. The name, email and notes you enter there go to Cal.com and onto my calendar, and are covered by Cal.com’s privacy policy.
  • Links to Instagram, LinkedIn, GitHub and YouTube take you to those sites, which have their own policies.

Fonts and media are served from this site, so your browser doesn’t contact Google or other third parties just by loading a page.

5. Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete anything you’ve sent me. Email work@captainsolo.ca and I’ll handle it within 30 days, in line with Canada’s PIPEDA.

6. Children

This site isn’t aimed at children under 13, and I don’t knowingly collect their information.

7. Changes

If this policy changes, the new version goes on this page with a new date.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
terms-of-service.html:
Last updated: October 20, 2026

1. Acceptance of terms

By using captainsolo.ca (the “Service”) you agree to these terms.

2. Services

Captain Solo provides:

  • Voice tag and producer tag creation
  • Web development
  • Videography and video production
  • Related creative services

3. Orders and payments

  • Payment: price, deposit and payment method are agreed in writing for each project before work begins. Voice-tag orders placed on AirGigs are also covered by AirGigs’ terms.
  • Refunds: handled case by case. Once work has begun, refunds may be partial or unavailable.
  • Delivery: delivery times are estimates, not guarantees. I’ll tell you about any delay.

4. Intellectual property

  • Client ownership: once paid in full, you get full commercial rights to the delivered work, including monetized content.
  • Portfolio use: I may show completed work in my portfolio and marketing unless we agree otherwise.

5. Revisions

Revisions are listed on each service: 2 for a single voice tag, up to 10 for the Producer Brand Pack, and as agreed in writing for web and video projects. Extra revisions may cost more.

6. Your responsibilities

  • Give accurate information.
  • Send the materials and feedback the work needs, on time.
  • Use the Service lawfully.

Captain Solo isn’t liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages arising from use of the Service.

You agree to indemnify Captain Solo against claims, damages, losses and expenses arising from your use of the Service.

9. Changes to terms

11. Contact

Questions: work@captainsolo.ca.
